name: EU/EEA/Swiss Right of Residence

requirements.blocker_text: EU/EEA/Swiss citizens may reside in Bulgaria for up to 3 months on a valid ID card or passport alone, with no residence permit required.

Beyond 3 months, an EU/EEA/Swiss citizen must register for a long-term residence certificate (based on employment, self-employment, sufficient means plus insurance, or student status), submitted within 3 months of arrival; processed within 24 hours.
requirements.fix_path: Register with the Migration Directorate within 3 months of arrival.

evidence_required.document: Valid EU/EEA/Swiss ID card or passport
Proof of employment, self-employment, sufficient means, or student status (for registration beyond 3 months)

outcome.duration_length: long-term residence certificate valid up to 5 years; permanent residence available after 5 continuous years

sources.title: Ministry of Interior, Migration Directorate -- Citizens of EU: free movement for up to 3 months on ID/passport alone, long-term residence certificate registration thereafter (employment/self-employment/means/student basis), permanent residence after 5 consecutive years

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Bulgaria). Structurally distinct from the third-country-national routes: entry itself is automatic (no assessed application), but unlike some EU states, Bulgaria still requires EU/EEA/Swiss citizens to register for a long-term residence certificate after the initial 3-month period -- modeled as a second hard requirement rather than presenting the route as fully unconditional. citizenship_after_months (60) reflects the standard naturalisation residence bar (bg_naturalisation.json); EU citizens get no separate fast-track under the Citizenship Act provisions located in this pass.
